purpose: Diagnose missing RGB during approach in the stopped V5 development experiment. Compare three fixed camera configurations on retained states before proposing a separate physical experiment.
trace_selection: Both exposed nominal live visibility failures plus the exposed successful relay and the only both-nominal-pass seed. Invalid starts are outside this image diagnostic; they remain failures in V5.
frame_selection: Nearest saved frame to each of 32 equally spaced times from zero to min(3.05, final saved time). Remove duplicate indices without replacement.
camera_settings: Each array is azimuth degrees, elevation degrees and distance metres. Slots retain the observer's three names; each configuration records its actual camera calibration. The existing fixed look-at point is unchanged.
method: Replay recorded qpos/qvel into a scoring-only simulator, render RGB and apply the frozen FP32 OpenVINO observer with two-view confidence and rigid geometry unchanged. The observer receives only images and actual fixed calibration. Simulator bottle keypoints score error after inference; no robot controller executes.
selection: At most one non-original configuration passing every diagnostic gate; select most recovered original-refused frames, then lowest accepted p95 error. Report every configuration and frame. A diagnostic pass is not a perception holdout, physical success or promotion.
next_gate: Any selected camera configuration requires a separately declared fresh perception test and physical development/final splits before use. V5 remains stopped; all reserved V3/V4/V5 final scenes remain unexposed.
